input: lets have a consistently updated site with a enineering manager pov of the monorepo on the ghps. I think this is a long term consistently updated page for ease of viewing whats being worked on and an overview of the project.
task: Owner request: an always-current engineering-manager status page for the monorepo on GitHub Pages (/engineering/).
errors: PR links were rendered without https:// (regex match lacked the scheme); check.mjs caught 13 dead links on the first full build.
First version counted only merge commits; most PRs land as squash merges, so it read 16 of 66 first-parent commits. Now reads both.
build.test.mjs requires data-pf-to="hub" on every non-root page; added to the page's back link.

doc_friction.issue: Pages suites listed as one checklist line; build.test.mjs alone ran >10 min alongside run_workflow_locally --for-changes, which also hit the 10-min tool limit and had to be backgrounded.

deviations.why: route drew the ventures track; the owner named a site/platform task, so recorded as process.

notes: Run records begin 2026-10-13, so the page shows no week-over-week session delta until two weeks of records exist. 5 pages/marketing test failures (paywall wording on hub, error-keeper og/sitemap, mileage-log JSON-LD, catch-all size) are venture content on main, not this change.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: data design across 8 committed sources, ~700 lines of JS page generator with charts and graceful degradation, tests, build/check integration

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
